name: n-m3u8dl-re
description: Cross-platform HLS/DASH/MSS stream downloader with decryption, muxing, and live recording (N_m3u8DL-RE)

install_steps: curl -sSfL https://github.com/nilaoda/N_m3u8DL-RE/releases/latest/download/N_m3u8DL-RE_Linux_x64_$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz -o /tmp/nm3u8.tar.gz || curl -sSfL $(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/nilaoda/N_m3u8DL-RE/releases/latest | grep -o 'https://[^"]*linux_x64[^"]*\.tar\.gz' | head -1) -o /tmp/nm3u8.tar.gz && tar xzf /tmp/nm3u8.tar.gz -C ~/.local/bin N_m3u8DL-RE && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/N_m3u8DL-RE

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install N_m3u8DL-RE: download a release binary from https://github.com/nilaoda/N_m3u8DL-RE/releases

commands.description: Download a stream (m3u8/mpd/mss URL); flags like --save-dir, --save-name via passthrough

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install N_m3u8DL-RE: download a release binary from https://github.com/nilaoda/N_m3u8DL-RE/releases

args.name: url
args.description: Stream URL (m3u8/mpd/mss) or local manifest file

commands.description: Download with automatic best-quality stream selection (--auto-select)

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install N_m3u8DL-RE: download a release binary from https://github.com/nilaoda/N_m3u8DL-RE/releases

commands.description: Record a live stream, merging segments in real time (--live-real-time-merge)

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install N_m3u8DL-RE: download a release binary from https://github.com/nilaoda/N_m3u8DL-RE/releases

commands.description: Passthrough to N_m3u8DL-RE CLI (--key for decryption, -M for muxing, --thread-count, etc.)
